# Real-Data Index Iron Condor Comparison — 2 Years (Jul 2024 to Jul 2026)

**Data:** NSE F&O bhavcopy real settlement prices, real per-trade-day lot size (NewBrdLotQty -- lot sizes were revised mid-window, e.g. NIFTY 25->75; using the entry day's actual lot, not a frozen value). NIFTY: weekly cycles. BANKNIFTY/FINNIFTY/NIFTYNXT50/MIDCPNIFTY: monthly cycles (weeklies discontinued/never existed). **Exit rules:** 55% profit-take, 2.2x credit stop, else hold to expiry.
